items.name: b12435
items.body:
<details open>

vulkan: make the radix top-k tie selection deterministic (#31931)

* vulkan: make the radix top-k tie selection deterministic

The radix select gathers the elements above the threshold and the ties
with an atomic counter, so with more ties than remaining slots the kept
columns depend on the thread scheduling.

Each subgroup now owns a contiguous chunk of the row with the same
column mapping in every pass, counts its kept elements, and writes them
at ranks from a scan of the subgroup totals; overflowing ties are ranked
in column order with a ballot, so the lowest tied columns win, as on
CUDA and Metal. The radix pipelines require subgroup arithmetic, ballot
and full subgroups. Enable the deterministic top-k check on Vulkan.

* optimize shader for AMD, Intel and Nvidia

---------

Co-authored-by: Ruben Ortlam <rortlam@redhat.com>

</details>

items.body:
<details open>

cuda : fix MUL_MAT_ID abort with odd src0 columns on AMD (#32385)

On AMD devices MUL_MAT_ID with an F32, F16 or BF16 src0 and at most 8 tokens always used MMVF.
MMVF reads src0 in pairs of values and asserts an even ne[0], so a rank 1 LoRA on MoE expert weights (lora_b has ne[0] == 1) aborted.
Use MMVF there only for an even ne[0]; other shapes take the existing fallback.

Fixes #30576

Assisted-by: GitHub Copilot

Signed-off-by: AMD ROCm Contributor <91481003+liminfei-amd@users.noreply.github.com>

</details>

items.body:
<details open>

server: answer reasoning_effort levels the template rejects with 400 (#32332)

The reasoning effort probe already renders every candidate level, but
it dropped the ones the template raises on, so a request with such a
level (e.g. max on Qwen3.8) reached the template and came back as a
500 on /v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses and /v1/messages.

Keep the raising levels in reasoning_effort_rejected and reject them
in oaicompat_chat_params_parse with an invalid_argument, which the
server answers with a 400 listing the supported levels. Aliases and
levels a template ignores are not rejected, so high on Qwen3.8
still renders as xhigh.

Also trim the output_config.effort test to a single level.

</details>
